news.title: Alex Ovechkin's 'cool' final home opener marked by sons introducing him pregame
news.ruTitle: «Крутой» последний домашний дебют Алекса Овечкина был отмечен сыновьями, представившими его перед игрой
news.description: On the occasion of his final NHL home opener, Alex Ovechkin described it as "pretty cool" when his sons, Ilya and Sergei Ovechkin, were given the microphone to announce their father in player introductions Wednesday.

news.title: Kyle Connor scores twice, Jets beat Avalanche 3-2 for 3rd straight victory
news.ruTitle: Кайл Коннор забивает дважды, Джетс обыграли Эвеланш со счетом 3:2 и одержали третью победу подряд
news.description: — Kyle Connor broke a tie with a minute left with his second goal of game, Stuart Skinner made 32 saves and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Wednesday night for their third straight victory.

news.title: Capitals top Penguins 5-3 in Alex Ovechkin's final home opener in Washington
news.ruTitle: «Кэпиталз» обыграли «Пингвинз» со счетом 5:3 в последнем домашнем матче Алекса Овечкина в Вашингтоне.
news.description: — Tom Wilson had a goal and two assists, and the Washington Capitals held on for a win in Alex Ovechkin's final home opener, 5-3 over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Wednesday night.

news.title: U10 hockey owner says parents' jackets violate trademark, threatens suspension

news.description: Mothers of players in the U10 club made jackets with "Hitmen" on the front and "Hitmama Hockey" on the back.

news.title: Islanders D Alexander Romanov out 6-8 months with torn ACL
news.ruTitle: Защитник "Айлендерс" Александр Романов выбыл на 6-8 месяцев из-за разрыва передней крестообразной связки.
news.description: The Islanders said Wednesday that defenseman Alexander Romanov has a torn ACL and is expected to be out 6-8 months.
